backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no methods defined.
feature_evidence.json: Report listing implemented features with associated files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend React, game, PWA, and utility files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining global OKLCH color tokens and dark mode variables for the app.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with video editor metadata, PWA settings, and references to the root script and icons.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest describing app metadata, colors, icons, shortcuts, and permissions for the video editor.
frontend/public/offline.html: Offline fallback page providing connection status, retry option, and privacy messaging for the PWA.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling caching, offline support, and navigation/network-first fetching logic.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component setting up service worker registration, header with help dialog, and the video editor screen.
frontend/src/components/AboutHelp.tsx: Displays privacy info, feature list, and PWA install instructions for the video editor.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioTogg: Card component allowing users to toggle audio muting for exported videos.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: UI panel that exports a processed video, showing progress, errors, and a download option.
frontend/src/components/editor/TrimContr: Provides sliders and inputs to adjust video trim start/end times and displays resulting duration.
frontend/src/components/OnlineRequiredBl: Shows a full-screen blocker when offline with a retry button for restoring internet connectivity.
frontend/src/components/PwaInstallInstru: Presents dialog with manual PWA installation steps for Android and iPhone and a close button.
Provides dialog for sharing a game via native share, WhatsApp, or manual link copying with status feedback.
Wraps ShadCN dialog content with standardized styling, layout, and transitions.
frontend/src/components/VideoEditorScree: Main video editor UI handling file upload, trimming, audio toggling, export options, and offline status.
frontend/src/components/VirtualCurrencyP: Displays demo virtual currency balances with daily claim logic, countdown timer, and reset option.
frontend/src/game/controls/TouchControls: Implements on-screen touch buttons for left, right, and brake controls using pointer events.
frontend/src/game/controls/useGameContro: Maintains shared game control state with keyboard listeners and a React hook for subscribing.
frontend/src/game/original/OriginalCanva: Canvas-based game that handles rendering, player movement, obstacle spawning, collisions, and scoring.
frontend/src/game/original/OriginalGameS: Shell component that manages start, play, and game-over flow for the original canvas game, plus settings and dialogs.
frontend/src/game/original/settings/defa: Defines default game settings and difficulty presets for speed and spawn rate.
frontend/src/game/original/settings/useC: Custom hook managing creator control settings with localStorage persistence and reset capability.
frontend/src/game/original/types.ts: Defines game state, settings, defaults, and stats interfaces for the original game.
frontend/src/game/original/ui/CreatorCon: UI dialog for adjusting gameplay settings such as difficulty, speed, and spawn rate.
frontend/src/game/original/ui/GameHud.ts: HUD component displaying current score and high score during gameplay.
frontend/src/game/original/ui/GameStartS: Start screen with hero image, instructions, high score, and navigation buttons for game actions.
frontend/src/game/original/ui/LegalOwner: Dialog showing legal notices about asset ownership, code access, and non-gambling disclaimer.
frontend/src/game/scene/PlayerCarModel.t: 3D player car model built from textured and colored mesh components using Three.js.
Three.js scene managing player movement, obstacle spawning, collision logic, and roadside elements.
frontend/src/game/teenpatti/engine/ai.ts: Implements a simple probabilistic AI that evaluates hand strength and chooses fold, call, or raise.
frontend/src/game/teenpatti/engine/cards: Defines card types and provides deck creation, shuffling, and hand dealing utilities.
frontend/src/game/teenpatti/engine/gameS: Manages game state transitions including betting actions, folding, raising, calling, and showdown resolution.
frontend/src/game/teenpatti/engine/handR: Evaluates Teen Patti hands, determines rankings, and compares two hands to find the winner.
frontend/src/game/teenpatti/TeenPattiGam: Main game container handling state, player actions, AI responses, and transitions between phases.
frontend/src/game/teenpatti/ui/TeenPatti: UI component providing fold, call, and raise controls with raise input and quick-raise options.
Renders a single Teen Patti card face-up or face-down with suit symbols and styling.
Displays end-of-hand results, hand evaluations, chip counts, and a button to play the next hand.
Renders the Teen Patti start screen with title, quick rules, virtual currency panel, and buttons to start the game or view rules.
Displays the main Teen Patti gameplay table including opponent and player cards, pot info, virtual currency, and action controls.
frontend/src/game/TrafficJamGame.tsx: Main wrapper for the 3D Traffic Jam game, managing game state, score, restarts, and online checks.
frontend/src/game/ui/CanvasErrorBoundary: Error boundary that catches rendering errors and shows a fallback UI with retry support.
frontend/src/game/ui/GameHud.tsx: Shows score and a game-over screen with restart button for the Traffic Jam game.
frontend/src/game/ui/SceneRenderFallback: Fallback component explaining render failures and offering a retry button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalVideoFile.ts: Manages a locally selected video file, generating object URLs and handling cleanup.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnlineStatus.ts: Tracks the device’s online/offline state and allows manual rechecking.
frontend/src/hooks/usePwaInstall.ts: Handles PWA installation flow, tracking installability, installation status, and prompting the user.
frontend/src/hooks/useVirtualCurrency.ts: Implements a React hook for storing, updating, and claiming virtual currency with localStorage persistence and a 24h cooldown timer.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode palettes, and custom component utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/videoExport.ts: Provides a video export function that trims, processes frames via canvas, optionally includes audio, and records output using MediaRecorder.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app root with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/iframeNavigation.ts: Adds helpers for detecting iframe embedding and performing safe navigation or opening URLs in new tabs.
frontend/src/utils/shareUrl.ts: Generates sanitized share and install URLs by constructing clean links and removing all hash fragments.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, themes, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Contains project metadata, constraints, known issues, and requirements for the web app’s direction and features.
